compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AP7365-33YG-13 assigns OUT (VOUT) whereas LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB assigns INPUT (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: AP7365-33YG-13 assigns IN (VIN) whereas LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB assigns OUTPUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: Check PCB land pattern & height profile.
A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: AP7365-33YG-13 uses SOT-89-3 (3-pin, Y (SOT89)) while LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB uses SOT-223-3 (3-pin, DCY (IMP)); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT). Soldering LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB onto a AP7365-33YG-13 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: AP7365-33YG-13 is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 1 µF, p.1), whereas LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.01–3 Ω (p.13)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB can trigger control-loop oscillation.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 10x (AP7365-33YG-13: 1 µF p.1 vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB: 10 µF p.13); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP7365-33YG-13 is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.3) vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB at 26 V rec. (26 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB supplies up to 400 mA (p.5) compared to AP7365-33YG-13 at 600 mA (p.3); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AP7365-33YG-13: 300 mV p.3 vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB: 500 mV p.5); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP7365-33YG-13 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6.5 V, p.3) than LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB (26 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6.5 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 128% higher on AP7365-33YG-13 (AP7365-33YG-13: 133 °C/W p.4 vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB: 58.3 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB requires Vin,min >= 4.3 V (p.4) vs 2 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
CAUTION LIFECYCLE STATUS (NRND): AP7365-33YG-13 is flagged NRND by Diodes Incorporated; do not design into new production layouts — evaluate Active alternatives.
engineering_verdict: AP7365-33YG-13 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-89-3) and LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 33.9 °C on AP7365-33YG-13 (θJA 133 °C/W) vs 14.9 °C on LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB (θJA 58.3 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 57.1x ratio (35 µA (p.3) vs 2000 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP7365-33YG-13 "NRND Lifecycle Banner on Page 1 — Diodes Inc Directs New Designs to AP7366" (p.1) and LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB "CRITICAL Pinout & Tab Reversal vs. 1117 Family — Installing on 1117 Pads Shorts VOUT to GND" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose AP7365-33YG-13 when load current exceeds 400 mA (up to 600 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 35 µA Iq; choose LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB when input rails climb above 6 V (rated to 26 V) or lower package θJA (58.3 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
